document.purpose: Source-of-truth career data for generating job-specific CVs
generation_rules: Use only facts present in this file.
Do not invent employers, dates, metrics, qualifications, responsibilities, technologies, certificates, awards, or contact details.
Select and reorder the most relevant evidence for the supplied job description.
A generated summary may paraphrase verified facts but must not add unsupported claims.
Keep project contribution statements explicit when a project was co-developed.
Treat repository creation and push dates as repository metadata, not as confirmed project-duration dates.
Omit null, empty, or unverified fields from a generated CV.
Prefer concise, ATS-friendly wording and conventional section names.
Ask the candidate before adding any information listed under data_gaps.

professional_summary.canonical: Full-stack developer working at the intersection of Linux systems and agentic AI. Builds stateful AI workflows, retrieval-augmented applications, secure backend systems, and usable web interfaces with TypeScript, Python, React, and Next.js. Recent work includes a Unix-like shell in C++20, LangGraph-based agents, hybrid retrieval with source citations, and production-oriented authentication and data workflows.
professional_summary.short: Full-stack and AI systems engineer building agentic workflows, RAG applications, secure backends, and modern web interfaces.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

experience.notes: The public profile provides the title and dates but no verified responsibility bullets.

highlights: Developed B2B SaaS dashboard features with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Translated more than 20 Figma designs into responsive components with shadcn/ui while maintaining consistency across desktop and mobile.
Integrated REST APIs with Redux and Zustand and resolved UI bugs across browsers and dashboard modules.
Developed a multi-vendor e-commerce platform with two role-based dashboards for food and gift product modules.
Built more than 15 REST API endpoints for orders, products, and vendor operations with shared MongoDB schemas and validation middleware.
Improved database query response times by 40% using Mongoose lean queries, projections, and compound indexes.
Implemented NextAuth.js authentication, JWT sessions, role-based access, and transactional emails through Resend.
Applied Laravel routing, controllers, Eloquent ORM, and Blade templates in backend development.
Built server-side logic and database interactions using the Model-View-Controller pattern.
Worked with MySQL queries, migrations, and Laravel's schema builder.
Collaborated with senior developers, participated in code reviews, and followed team development practices.

skills.usage_note: The profile presents these technologies as part of the candidate's stack. Do not infer a proficiency level or years of experience unless another entry provides direct evidence.

projects.name: myShell
projects.summary: A Unix-like shell implemented in C++20 from parsing through terminal and process-group control.
highlights: Built a quote-aware parser supporting environment assignments, parameter expansion, aliases, simple functions, pipelines, redirections, and background operators.
Implemented concurrent pipeline execution with one child process per stage, shared process groups, correct file-descriptor wiring, and final-stage exit status propagation.
Added foreground and background job control with terminal handoff and jobs, fg, and bg built-ins.
Coordinated Ctrl+C, Ctrl+backslash, and Ctrl+Z behavior so signals reach foreground jobs without terminating the shell.
Implemented left-to-right redirection semantics, descriptor duplication and closure, plus restoration of parent file descriptors after built-ins.
Added PATH-based command caching, aliases, functions, persistent environment assignments, and command history.
Created CTest unit coverage and pseudo-terminal integration tests for parsing, execution, signals, process groups, terminal ownership, and job control.

projects.name: AutoHunt
projects.summary: A stateful job-application workflow that parses CVs, discovers and scores jobs, drafts and critiques cover letters, pauses for human review, and supports browser-driven submission.
highlights: Orchestrated a 10-stage LangGraph state machine covering CV parsing, job discovery, relevance scoring, filtering, cover-letter drafting and refinement, human review, browser automation, tracking, and email digest composition.
Implemented Playwright automation for navigating job portals, locating form fields, and filling applications from structured résumé data.
Used OpenAI and Groq Llama 3.3 for semantic job-CV matching and an iterative critic-refiner cover-letter loop.
Built a PDF parsing pipeline with pdfjs-dist and validated CV data, job listings, model outputs, and application forms with Zod.
Added human-in-the-loop graph interruptions before application submission.
Persisted LangGraph checkpoints in PostgreSQL and tracked local application history in SQLite.
Built a Next.js dashboard for live workflow status, job browsing, skill matches, and application statistics.

projects.name: DocsAI
projects.summary: A document-analysis assistant with separate ingestion and RAG chat workflows, streamed answers, and source-aware citations.
highlights: Built an AI pre-check that validates whether an uploaded PDF contains legal or compliance content before ingestion.
Combined OpenAI dense embeddings and SPLADE sparse vectors in Qdrant, then applied Cohere reranking.
Created position-aware PDF chunking that retains page and estimated text coordinates for citation highlighting.
Delivered generated text and citations through server-sent events.
Separated document ingestion and chat generation into independent LangGraph pipelines.
Maintained conversation isolation with PostgreSQL-backed thread context.
Integrated Groq Llama 3.3 for generation, OpenAI for embeddings, Cohere for reranking, Qdrant for retrieval, and Cloudinary for PDF storage.

projects.name: Vidspire / Vidly
projects.summary: A platform that analyzes YouTube comments and transcripts to surface sentiment, emotions, content patterns, and actionable insights.
highlights: Architected asynchronous analysis jobs with BullMQ and Redis, including worker concurrency and rate limits.
Built a seven-stage LangGraph workflow with sentiment classification and parallel analysis of emotions, patterns, loved aspects, improvements, and viewer requests.
Implemented WebSocket progress updates across queuing, data retrieval, analysis, and completion stages.
Fetched YouTube comments and transcripts in parallel with graceful fallback handling.
Implemented rotation across eight Google Gemini API keys to distribute load and reduce rate-limit bottlenecks.
Added Redis-backed rate limiting, structured Zod outputs, Resend notifications, and production deployment on Render.
Contributed Next.js interface improvements and SEO work deployed through Vercel.

projects.name: Better Auth Starter
projects.summary: A Next.js authentication starter covering sign-in, account management, two-factor authentication, and transactional email.
highlights: Implemented email and password authentication plus GitHub and Google OAuth.
Added email verification, account linking, TOTP-based two-factor authentication, backup codes, and session management.
Implemented profile updates, password changes and resets, and account deletion workflows.
Used PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM, Zod validation, and Resend with React Email templates.

projects.name: Nest E-Commerce API
projects.summary: A modular NestJS e-commerce API supporting account flows, seller applications, stores, product management, public catalog browsing, shopping carts, and product reviews.
highlights: Implemented JWT access tokens and rotating refresh tokens, with refresh tokens hashed in the database.
Added email verification, user account and session management, password changes, and account deletion.
Implemented customer, seller, rider, and admin roles with application and approval workflows.
Built seller-owned store and product management with ownership validation and Cloudinary image uploads.
Added a paginated public catalog with search, price, store, and sorting filters.
Implemented persistent shopping carts and user-owned product reviews.
Created configurable development seed tooling for users, stores, products, images, and idempotent reviews.
limitations: The repository README states that checkout, orders, addresses, and wishlists are not yet implemented.

projects.name: Event Horizon
projects.summary: A responsive cinematic astronomy experience combining realtime WebGL scenes, custom GLSL shaders, motion-led storytelling, and accessible fallbacks.
highlights: Created a custom GLSL black-hole effect with ray bending, accretion-disk shading, bloom, and spectral edge separation.
Built React Three Fiber scenes for a black hole, procedural spiral galaxy, nebula atmosphere, and neutron star.
Implemented scroll-linked scene movement, lazy initialization with IntersectionObserver, and offscreen animation pausing.
Reduced geometry and effects on smaller devices and added reduced-motion support.
Added semantic labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, a skip link, and static poster fallbacks for unavailable or lost WebGL contexts.
Created Playwright-based browser verification for interactions and fallbacks.

projects.name: Algo Arena
projects.summary: A React and TypeScript frontend for a LeetCode-style coding platform with authentication, problem management, code submission, and Judge0-powered execution.
highlights: Implemented Supabase sign-up and login flows.
Built interfaces for browsing, adding, editing, and attempting data-structure and algorithm problems.
Integrated code submission and execution workflows designed around the Judge0 API.
Created a responsive interface using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui.

projects.name: CamBot
projects.summary: A Next.js chatbot that retrieves relevant institutional documents from Supabase and streams context-grounded responses for Sahara Medical College Narowal.
highlights: Generated query embeddings with OpenAI text-embedding-3-large.
Used a Supabase remote procedure call to retrieve up to eight matching document chunks with a similarity threshold.
Injected retrieved context into a constrained system prompt designed to avoid unsupported answers.
Streamed responses from GPT-4o mini through the Vercel AI SDK.
Built chat, about, and admin-facing routes with a responsive Next.js interface.

projects.name: Personal Portfolio
projects.summary: A responsive personal portfolio presenting experience, projects, technology stack, social links, GitHub activity, and contact options.
highlights: Built a responsive single-page portfolio with introduction, experience, projects, social links, and a downloadable CV.
Added a categorized technology grid, GitHub contribution graph, and light and dark themes.
Implemented a contact form using React Hook Form, Zod, and EmailJS.
Separated profile, project, experience, technology, and social-link content into maintainable data modules.
Configured type checking, linting, and production build checks.

professional_interests: Agent design with explicit state and conditional routing
Hybrid retrieval, reranking, and source-grounded answers

project_selection.method: Five projects explicitly featured in the GitHub profile README, followed by five additional repositories selected for technical depth, distinct evidence, documentation quality, and relevance to the candidate's stated focus areas.

data_gaps: Project start and completion dates distinct from repository metadata
